context.body: Genesis through Deuteronomy distinguishes requests, responses, priestly formulas, intercession, restitution, pardon, retained consequence, and stated refusal to pardon. The bounded source is Exodus 10:16–20.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Pharaoh confesses, asks forgiveness and prayer, receives relief.
observations.label: Pharaoh asks forgiveness and returns to refusal: action

observations.body: again refuses release when his heart is hardened.
observations.label: Pharaoh asks forgiveness and returns to refusal: response

payload.posture: Read Exodus 10:16–20 as requests, law, and pardon evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Pharaoh’s confession and forgiveness request receive relief, but the narrated refusal returns; the request cannot certify repentance or restored obedience.
payload.title: Pharaoh asks forgiveness and returns to refusal
